results.name: blobService
results.reason: Learn latest GA selector is 2026-09-01. Exact current and GA REST OpenAPI paths both fix the Blob Service route suffix to /blobServices/default; request body model has no required properties. No payload properties are used.
results.migration: GA移行可能。current 2026-04-01とGA 2026-09-01でBlob Service routeとBlobServiceProperties shapeに差なし。Learn breaking-change logは2026-04、2026-06、2026-09で追加・更新・削除なし。

findings.detail: 最新GA candidate 2026-09-01がcurrent 2026-04-01より新しい。resource name default is fixed in the REST route and no mutable payload properties are used; change log reports no changes.

usage.label: name
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /name is Bicep child identity, not a JSON body field. Exact current and candidate REST PUT/GET route is storageAccounts/{accountName}/blobServices/default, so literal 'default' matches the service's fixed name.

usage.label: parent
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /parent is a Bicep parent relationship, not REST JSON. The storageAccount parent supplies the accountName path segment; the REST child route is fixed to blobServices/default.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$expression-line/0 is the Bicep resource type/version header, not a REST payload field. Learn selector lists latest GA 2026-09-01; current remains 2026-04-01.

current.analysis: Learn exact current API page and pinned stable OpenAPI were checked. PUT request takes BlobServiceProperties; its properties have no required members. Exact route suffix is /blobServices/default.

ga.analysis: Learn unversioned selector lists 2026-09-01 as latest GA. Pinned stable/2026-09-01/openapi.json confirms same exact fixed route and BlobServiceProperties body contract.

breaking.analysis: Learn change log reports no properties added, updated, or removed for 2026-04-01, 2026-06-01, or 2026-09-01.
